cumulativeFindings.title: Premium calculation has arithmetic owner but no safe canonical rate authority.
demonstratedFacts: Current engine arithmetic is primaNeta + gastosEmision + gastosFinancieros + otros = baseGravable; IVA = baseGravable * ivaPct; primaTotal = baseGravable + IVA.
Financial surcharge is calculated as primaNeta * recargoFinPct only when fraccionado.
Receipt splitting preserves total by placing component/IVA rounding residue in the final applicable receipt.
B3 financial audit recomputed 7 complete samples with 0 formula mismatch and 0 IVA mismatch.
Tariff diagnostic found zero valid canonical configuracionesTarifa, zero valid embedded tariff configurations and zero tariff samples with source/version/validity authority.

core/primas.js falls back to generic IVA=12 and recargoFinanciero=5 if no country config exists, while the canonical policy form falls back to CO IVA=19 / otherwise 12 and blank recargo becomes 0. These paths are not a safe contractual authority.

sourceHierarchy: Authoritative insurer/policy document or approved imported source values.
Canonical tariff configuration keyed by country + insurer + ramo/subramo/product + payment frequency/conditions + validity/version/source.
Explicit user-entered components/rates with audit reason when source legitimately requires manual entry.
Generic country defaults are display aids only and MUST NOT certify or silently create insurer/product contractual amounts.
frozenContract.totalRule: If authoritative source provides primaTotal, preserve that contractual total. Do not overwrite it merely because components are missing.
frozenContract.componentValidationRule: If authoritative source provides complete components/rates, recompute and compare. A material mismatch is an exception requiring resolution; do not silently overwrite source.
frozenContract.incompleteRule: If primaNeta exists but one or more required contractual rates/components are unknown, do not fabricate primaTotal from generic defaults. Mark calculation pending/needs authority.
frozenContract.calculatedRule: When all required components are authoritative, calculate total from the explicit signed components and tax base defined by that product configuration; display source total and calculated total separately until they reconcile.
frozenContract.installmentRule: The sum of generated receipts must equal the authoritative/canonical primaTotal exactly; rounding residual is assigned deterministically to the last applicable installment and never creates an extra receipt.
frozenContract.paymentPlanRule: Frequency determines expected installments unless authoritative source explicitly overrides; monthly may have an explicit installment count. Competing physical calendars remain fail-closed until authority resolves them.
frozenContract.currencyRule: Policy canonical currency governs linked financial projections; source currency is preserved as provenance and conflicts are flagged.
frozenContract.productionRule: Existing policy viewing is not blocked by missing tariff tables. New/edit policy auto-calculation IS blocked from inventing a total when rate/component authority is missing. Explicit authoritative total/components may still be persisted with audit.

cumulativeFindings.title: 81-case reconciliation must not depend on Paula starting work prematurely.
cumulativeFindings.closure: System-first source exhaustion followed by an explicit residual handoff to Paula only when required.

systemFirstActions: Resolve the 50 deterministic cases by controlled diff/readback; Paula does not research these.
Before asking Paula about any of the 31, inspect already available Project/GitHub/source files for prima total, frequency, installment count, competing schedules and insurer evidence.
Produce a residual list containing only unresolved policies, the exact missing field, acceptable evidence and proposed correction.
No ambiguous operational data write is authorized before source/Paula confirmation.
financialReconciliationCarry.paulaStartCondition: Paula starts manual work ONLY after ChatGPT explicitly says MANUAL_ACTION_START and supplies the residual list after source exhaustion.
financialReconciliationCarry.paulaInputProtocol: For each residual case Paula only supplies/marks what is missing (e.g. prima total, frequency, installment count, which package is current, and source/reference). She does not recalculate or reconcile the database.
financialReconciliationCarry.assistantAfterPaulaInput: Validate coherence, generate dry-run exact diff, show before/after, obtain authorization for operational correction if required, write with canonical readback and rollback evidence.

plan.principle: No new methodology or iteration. All work remains inside the active B4-003 gate and returns to the frozen plan.
